source: temosunrooms.com product pages, pulled 2026-09-25. Engineering values marked UNCONFIRMED are reference placeholders until TEMO supplies spec sheets.

claims.material: Heavy-gauge extruded aluminum with an electrostatic, maintenance-free finish (TEMKOR surfacing on contemporary lines)
claims.wind: Fixed pergolas rated for winds up to 220 mph (TEMO fixed-pergola page)
claims.shade: Fixed pergolas provide about 60% shade (TEMO fixed-pergola page)
claims.hail: Operable louvers withstand 95% of hail storms closed, 99% open (TEMO pergola FAQ)
claims.surfaces: Installs over wood decks, concrete pads or pavers
claims.upgradePath: Patio covers can later be upgraded to a screen room or full sunroom
claims.installTime: Patio covers typically install in 1 to 2 days on an approved foundation

styles.name: Classic
styles.desc: Arched roof with scalloped corbel rafter tails, doubled header beams and trimmed columns.

styles.name: Contemporary
styles.desc: Flat roof inside a clean box frame with square columns.

styles.name: Studio
styles.desc: Flat insulated roof with angled knee braces; flat ceiling ready for fans and lights.

styles.name: Santa Fe
styles.desc: Flat insulated roof with pergola lattice accents around the edge (attached only).

styles.name: Cathedral
styles.desc: Gable roof with a vaulted cathedral ceiling.

lines.name: Operable Pergola
lines.tagline: Motorized louvers: full sun to full cover at the touch of a button.

lines.name: Fixed Pergola
lines.tagline: Fixed louvers for about 60% shade, rated for 220 mph winds.

lines.name: Insulated Patio Cover
lines.tagline: Solid insulated roof in TEMO's Studio, Santa Fe or Cathedral style.
lines.roofPanelNote: Roof panels are white; ceiling can be upgraded to Tuscany Wood Grain.

options.name: LED lighting
options.sourceNote: TEMO: lighting accessories on pergolas; integrated lighting on contemporary pergolas; lighting on patio covers.

options.name: Ceiling fan
options.sourceNote: TEMO: ceiling fans on contemporary pergolas and patio covers/pavilions.

options.name: Infrared heater
options.sourceNote: TEMO: heaters on patio covers/pavilions (integrated beam systems). On pergolas: dealer add-on.

options.name: Retractable screen
options.sourceNote: TEMO: retractable shades, curtains and privacy panels on pergolas; curtain wall for retractable screens on St. Thomas/Skyview patio covers. Motorized screens: dealer add-on (e.g. Tucson Rolling Shutters).

options.name: Rain and wind sensor (auto-close)
options.sourceNote: Not listed by TEMO. Dealer add-on; confirm the dealer offers it before launch.

options.name: Tuscany Wood Grain ceiling
options.sourceNote: TEMO: Tuscany Wood Grain Finish ceiling panels for patio covers and sunrooms (2026).

options.name: Skylight panels (Skyview)
options.sourceNote: TEMO: skylights on attached patio covers; Skyview uses polycarbonate roof panels.

engineering_UNCONFIRMED.note: Placeholders from industry norms and Apollo's public limits. Replace with TEMO span charts before a real dealer quote.

pricing_DEMO_DEFAULTS.note: Planning ranges from 2026 published cost guides. Every dealer overrides these with their own numbers.

dealerAssets.access: Passcode protected. TEMO gives the passcode to authorized dealers; request it through the signed dealer.
dealerAssets.hotlinking: temosunrooms.com returns 403 to image requests without a TEMO referer. Always download and rehost approved images.

optionSourceKey: brand = on TEMO's own site; dealer = offered by dealers, not listed by TEMO; mixed = brand on some lines, dealer on others. Dealers can hide any option with pergolaStudio.hideOptions.
